fields.wiring: Exactly two incoming edges: one with target_handle "base" (the rows to keep) and one with target_handle "join" (the lookup frame).
fields.how: "left" keeps every base row; also "inner", "full", "semi", "anti" or "cross".
fields.on: Key columns present under the same name in both frames.
fields.leftOn / rightOn: Key columns when the names differ: leftOn on the base frame, rightOn on the join frame, in matching order. Use these instead of on.
fields.validate: Optional key check: "m:1" when each base row matches at most one lookup row, "1:1", "1:m" or "m:m".
fields.suffix: Appended to a join-frame column whose name clashes with a base column; default "_right".
fields.coalesce: Optional; true merges the key columns of a full join.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: Attach each policy's region relativity by region code.

configs.name: realistic
configs.intent: Attach region relativities, checking each policy matches at most one region.
